description: Permanently deletes one private diary entry belonging to the connected account after the user explicitly confirms that exact entry. Use its saved diary ID from Enshape and verify ambiguous or stale entries before deleting. If the outcome is uncertain, check the diary before retrying with the same ID. A deleted:false result means the entry is absent and does not identify who removed it. Each valid attempt, including retries and missing entries, consumes one shared diary call. Only the private diary is affected.

confirmed.description: User explicitly confirmed deletion of this exact diary entry.

mealId.description: Persisted private diary entry ID, not a catalog ID.

name: delete_meal
title: Delete a meal from Enshape
